value_proposition.explanation: Taken together, the documents position the product around simple, occasional home tasks: labels, forms, worksheets, home organization, and light creative projects. The prompt bank prioritizes ordinary home surfaces with those materials, while keeping office, café, gaming, education, and studio scenes clearly marked when they move beyond the home-first source context.
